entry.name: jsui
entry.digest: Javascript user interfaces and graphics (Legacy Engine)
entry.description: Provides an environment to make user interface elements using Javascript (ECMAScript 5). This provides all of the programming tools available in the js object, but also exposes the mgraphics and sketch drawing routines for visual output.

attributes.name: param_connect
attributes.digest: Connect to Parameter
attributes.description: Establishes a two-way connection between the object and a parameter of a compatible object with parameters such asor. The object can be used to change the value of the parameter and will update if the parameter value changes. The easiest way to setis with the attribute's menu in theor the Connect submenu of the. The menu displays all available parameters of compatible objects.Setting theattribute with a message requires the target parameter's path, which is the host object's scriping name followed by two colons and the parameter name. For example, for aobject with scripting name, the path of theparameter would be. You can set a value for thebefore the host object or parameter exists, and the object will connect to the parameter once it exists. Refer to the user guide entry forfor more details.

messages.name: (drag)
messages.description: When a file is dragged from the File Browser to aobject, the file is loaded and executed.

messages.name: (mouse)
messages.description: Double-clicking on aobject opens a text window where the object's Javascript source file can be edited. When the text window is saved, the text is compiled as the object's script.

messages.name: anything
messages.description: Invokes the function with the message name, assigning the message arguments to the arguments to the function. For example, if the object has a function named xyz defined, the messagewould invoke the xyz function with arguments 1 2 and 3.

messages.name: autowatch
messages.description: The word, followed by a 1, turns on file watching for the Javascript source file. When file watching is on, the file is recompiled automatically when it is modified. This allows you to use an external editor for your Javascript file. When you save the file, theobject will notice. autowatch 0 turns off file watching.

messages.name: bang
messages.description: Invokes the function named bang if defined.

messages.name: compile
messages.description: Recompiles the current file. If followed by a symbol, will load, compile, and set the currently loaded Javascript file to be the file specified by the symbol argument.

messages.name: delprop
messages.description: The word, followed by a name, deletes the named property.

messages.name: editfontsize
messages.digest: Change the editing window's font size
messages.description: Changes the font-size of the text used in the editing window which contains the object's Javascript source file.

messages.name: float
messages.description: Invokes the function named msg_float if defined.

messages.name: getprop
messages.digest: Get the value of a named property
messages.description: The word, followed by a name, outputs the value of the property name stored in the object out the left outlet.

messages.name: int
messages.description: Invokes the function named msg_int if defined.

messages.name: jsargs
messages.description: Sets the current Javascript arguments to any following message arguments.

messages.name: jsfile
messages.digest: Load and compile a Javascript file
messages.description: The word, followed by a symbol , loads, compiles, and sets the currently loaded Javascript file to be the Javascript file specified by the symbol argument.

messages.name: list
messages.description: Performs the same as.

messages.name: loadbang
messages.digest: Invokes the function named loadbang if defined.
messages.description: Call the loadbang function

messages.name: open
messages.description: Opens the text window where the object's Javascript source file can be edited.

messages.name: setprop
messages.description: The word, followed by name and one or more names or numbers, sets the named property to what follows the name. For example, after sending setpropto a js object. the xyz property would have a value of the list 1 2 3.

messages.name: size
messages.description: The word, followed by two int arguments, sets the width and height of theobject.

messages.name: statemessage
messages.description: Allows for the testing of messages passed to functions within the Javascript source file.

messages.name: wclose
messages.description: Closes the text window where the object's Javascript source file is edited.
